statement: The f100r page has two red cylindrical vessels and sixteen botanical drawings. This inventory uses the Beinecke colour scan as a second blind seat. Nearby script was located visually before assigning ZL identifiers by band and object order. The upper-right caption is split around a blue-tipped branch. Three lower caption loci remain candidates because of neighboring plant forms and the paragraph margin. Coordinates are estimates on the 1850-by-2597 Yale IIIF image. Both vessels are recorded with unassigned captions.

features.description: Tall red cylinder with a pale oval top, a single pale belt and a rounded lower outline.
Grouped green round, cup-like lobes with tapered tips on a shared curved stalk. Pale and rusty root strands bend down from the join.
Rust-coloured coiled branch with small arrow- or triangular-shaped green blades on short stalks and two fine curved basal extensions.
A central upright stalk with paired tapering, finely toothed green blades in three levels and a fan of delicate pale roots.
Green lobes form a jagged, radiating cluster above a curved pale stem with several claw-like roots.
Three green bell-like forms face up, left and right on a common branched stem. Each has a dark blue pointed tip. The thin roots have a rusty central section.
features.caption_uncertainty: Two short ink segments flank the upright blue-tipped branch. The visual inventory associates the split region with this drawing.

features.description: Three toothed green blades, each with one outlined spot, on a pale stalk ending in an irregular dark reddish base.
A series of narrow green blades radiates along one side of a curved pale oval outline, with fine recurved basal lines.
Single tall asymmetric green blade with irregular spurs, above a small reddish bent root and a fine downward stroke.
A sharply pointed green blade with several downward strips and a darkened patch. A curved, thick reddish root is visible beneath it.
A compact fan of curled, paired green blades over several orange-brown root strokes and longer fine pale filaments.
Two large green blades hang down on either side of pale central stalks and several fine branching roots.
Upright red cylinder with a pale greenish oval top, pale bands separating three red sections and a pale basal rim.
Three elongated green blades form a fork on one stalk. Its base is a pale pointed bundle with several fine internal lines.
features.caption_uncertainty: One inscription sits beside this stem and a second lies above the gap with the next drawing. Their unique attribution could not be resolved blind.

features.description: Dark green rounded lobes form a crown on several pale branches. A thick pale taper bends left and divides into fine strands.
A lone broad green blade with a toothed outline and scattered short internal marks hangs from a long arched stem, ending in several pale roots.
Several overlapping round, scalloped green blades on pale stalks that meet above a dark hook and finer projections.
Large, pointed, deeply toothed green blades on a pale bend, with several orange-brown roots extending to the sides and down.
features.caption_uncertainty: This short line aligns with the right end of the upper paragraph band. Its position also permits association with either of the two right-hand plants.
